name: chaty
description: Chat app with voice & video calls — Go backend + React (Vite) frontend, packaged for Android with Nitron.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix app && cd server && go mod download
scripts.build: npm install --prefix app --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix app && cd server && go build -o chaty .
scripts.start:https: npm run build && cd server && HTTPS=self ./chaty
